notes.title: Update Notice
notes.notes:
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
We have resolved the issue where the language temporarily reverted to Japanese after loading a save or playing a mini-game when switching languages.
Now you can enjoy the game in your selected language without needing to move between maps!

Additionally, we are aware of the feedback regarding the low quality of the English translations.
We are currently working on improving this as well.

notes.title: Currently Identified Bugs and Illustrations
notes.notes:
Currently Known Bug:
When changing the language setting, loading a saved game causes the language to revert to Japanese.
This issue resolves itself once you move to a different map.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but if the language reverts, please temporarily move to another map.

We are attempting to correct this issue through plugin modifications to eliminate the extra step of map transition. However, due to technical limitations, we have outsourced the fix to an external developer.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask for your patience until the issue is resolved.

Additionally, regarding the characters in-game:
These illustrations were originally purchased from the Japanese manga artist KATUU and subsequently modified and animated by myself.
Please note that no AI was used in this process.
KATUU specializes in manga and illustrations featuring characters with large breasts, so we encourage you to check out their work.

notes.title: Known Bugs and Fixes Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]A critical issue has been found where important items can be sold.[/b]
Some items are necessary for game progression and selling them will make further progress impossible.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Please be careful not to sell these items.
This issue has been fixed in the latest version, making these items unsellable.
